description: Receive authorization requests from merchant terminals, the payment API, and the hosted payment page; score fraud; tokenize; route to the card networks and return the response in real time
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 260,000 authorizations a day (peak 45 per second) and about $775,000 of merchant sales an hour stop; merchant agreements promise 99.9% monthly availability; after about 4 hours large merchants switch to backup processors and card brands and the sponsor bank expect an explanation
manual_workaround: None for card-not-present. Card-present merchants may take offline (deferred) authorizations only within their own floor limits and at their own risk
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (authorization switch, API and terminal gateways, token vault); SYS-02; SYS-04; SYS-09; SYS-05; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; payment HSM service; card networks (links under the sponsor bank's membership); content delivery service

description: Run scheduled charges for merchants' subscription customers using stored tokens
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Recurring batches can be re-run later the same day; late charges cause merchant complaints but no lost data
manual_workaround: Re-run the missed batch after recovery; merchants notified of the delay
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; payment HSM service; card networks

description: Build daily clearing files from approved transactions, send them to the card networks by the daily cutoff, and reconcile network settlement reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missing the daily network cutoff delays settlement for all 4,200 merchants; this is a covered service for the sponsor bank (12 CFR 53.4 notice if disrupted 4 or more hours); interchange downgrades raise costs
manual_workaround: Hold the file and send it in the next cutoff window; manual reconciliation from network reports
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (settlement and funding engine, database); SYS-02; SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; card networks; sponsor bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Settlement Operations Manager and 5 settlement staff; office or remote access

description: Calculate net amounts per merchant and send the daily ACH funding file to the sponsor bank, which originates the credits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants depend on next-day funding for payroll and inventory; the sponsor bank originates the ACH file on the processor's data (a covered service); wrong or late files cause losses and bank findings
manual_workaround: Send the prior day's validated file only after recalculation; sponsor bank can hold its ACH window for a few hours on request
dependent_people_or_facilities: CFO; Settlement Operations Manager; finance staff

description: Receive dispute notices from the networks, notify merchants, submit representments by network deadlines
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Network response windows are measured in days, so a short outage causes no lost cases; missed deadlines shift losses to merchants or the processor
manual_workaround: Work disputes from the network's own portal; track in a spreadsheet

description: Score transactions with the fraud model, review alerts and escalations, monitor merchants for fraud and excessive chargebacks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: If the model is unavailable, authorizations continue on the fallback rules engine with higher fraud losses; merchant risk reviews can wait a day
manual_workaround: Fallback velocity and amount rules in the authorization switch; analysts review large transactions by hand
dependent_people_or_facilities: Risk and Fraud Manager; 3 fraud analysts

description: Merchants view transactions and deposits, issue refunds, key in card numbers, and manage their users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants lose reporting and refunds; virtual terminal users (about 700 merchants) cannot take phone orders; reports can be regenerated
manual_workaround: Support staff issue urgent refunds through an internal tool with dual approval; merchants use their terminals

description: Answer merchant calls, tickets, and email about transactions, deposits, and access
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants need answers during outages; ticket history can be rebuilt from email
manual_workaround: Phone line forwarded to mobile phones; shared email inbox
dependent_people_or_facilities: 9 support staff; Florida office or remote

description: Collect and review logs and alerts for the CDE, run incident response, and send required notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: PCI DSS requires continuous log collection and daily review; a monitoring gap hides an attack and triggers a PCI DSS finding (10.7.2); notice clocks (card brand 3 days, FTC 30 days) keep running
manual_workaround: Cloud-native logs retained in the tenant for 7 days as a buffer; manual review of critical logs
dependent_third_parties: SIEM service; EDR service; cloud provider

description: Collect merchant applications, verify owners, underwrite, and board new merchants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 60 new merchants a month; a delay of a few days is acceptable
manual_workaround: Collect applications by secure upload and board later
dependent_third_parties: CRM SaaS provider; identity verification service

description: Company accounting, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; a missed payroll has legal and retention impact; terminations must still remove access on time
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; terminations handled by IT from the HR notice
